description:
Upload a local file directly to an existing Probo uploader URL. Use after createUploader.

Flow:
1. configureProduct → get calculation_id
2. createUploader({calculationId, callbackUrl}) → get uploadUrl
3. uploadFileToUploader({uploadUrl, filePath}) → file is uploaded

Supports .pdf, .jpg, .jpeg, .png files up to Probo's size limit.

filePath.description: Absolute local path to the file

name: uploadFileToUploader
